submitter: bugfix_388_component_contract_identity lane — ROUND 1. bugs_open/388 was filed 2026-08-25 by the 378 lane; this lane picked it up today, corrected two of its claims first-hand (its own [INFERRED] marker pointed at the soft one), and found the register entry that already names this defect as flagged-and-unbuilt (CLC-006/F4). The four adjacent lanes (345, 378, 283, 357) were contacted before drafting; 378, 345 and 283 have each replied with a measured no-conflict, and 283 supplied a measured negative that closes one of the risks below.
rationale:
WHAT IS BROKEN. component-creator's birth gate has a pre-generation half that tells the writer which field names it must preserve, and a store half that decides which content_components row a regeneration overwrites and enforces that contract against. They resolve the row by different means. The advisory (load_existing_component_action.go:170-179) queries WHERE section_type = $1 ORDER BY derived-usage-sites DESC, updated_at DESC. The store takes the function name the LLM emitted (store_generated_component_action.go:798-806, falling back to NormaliseToKebab(section_type) when the model supplies none) and resolves through resolveStorageIdentity, which looks up by function (component_storage_identity.go:167-176).

Since commit e1951c24b (the bugs_open/337 fix, live 2026-08-22) the two ARE bridged — by a sentence in the live prompt_template telling the writer to echo {{.existing_component.function}}. That is the real defect, and it is sharper than 'two resolvers exist': an identity decision is delegated to an LLM instruction, nothing validates it, nothing records a divergence, and the instruction renders solely inside {{if .existing_component.field_names}} — so the guard is conditional on the very thing it protects.

THIS IS NOT A NEW DISCOVERY BY THIS LANE. The concept register has carried it since the F4 investigation: CLC-006 'regen-vs-create keyed on the LLM-chosen function (silent fork)', status partial, whose own text says 'a store-side advisory ... is deliberately advisory-only and unbuilt' and whose verify-later asks for exactly two things — 'duplicate non-forked function rows in content_components; whether any store-side advisory exists'. Both are now answered and both answers are the bad one: two duplicate pairs exist from the generated route, and no store-side advisory exists (grepped; store_generated_component_action.go makes no comparison against collected_data.existing_component). 388 is CLC-006's unbuilt half, rediscovered from the data.

WHY THE FIX IS BY ROW ID AND NOT BY FUNCTION NAME — this is the load-bearing measurement. lookupBaseComponent filters ONLY on `function = $1 AND forked_from IS NULL`, ordering by is_active DESC, updated_at DESC, LIMIT 1. It filters neither component_level nor is_active (the latter deliberately, 2026-05-06, documented in its own comment). [MEASURED 2026-08-25] over 330 non-forked rows, 25 function values carry MORE THAN ONE row; the largest carry five (site-footer, site-header) and span component levels (section AND site; head spans head AND section; tool-agent-complexity-estimator spans section AND tool). So on 25 function values the store picks one of several rows by recency, and which one it picks can change with no code change at all. A pin carried by function NAME is structurally incapable of naming a row. This is the same conclusion RFC_034 §1 reached in the neighbouring programme and recorded as a correction: 'Convert by content_components.id, never by function; a function-keyed conversion would also silently skip 9 forked rows.'

The disconfirming result was available and would have decided against this design: had every function been unique among non-forked rows, a name-carried pin would have sufficed and the cheaper fix would have won.

WHY NOT THE BUG FILE'S OWN TOP-RANKED CANDIDATE. 388 ranks first 'make the primary path ask the store's resolver too'. That is the wrong direction and the filing lane has since agreed in writing. resolveStorageIdentity keys on NormaliseToKebab(section_type), which for the 27 divergent section_types names a different or nonexistent row — so it would stop the advisory naming the row dependents are actually bound to and push generations toward creating duplicates, converting an occasional silent fork into a systematic one. It also cannot touch the non-uniqueness above, because any name-keyed resolver inherits the name's ambiguity.

THE POPULATION. [MEASURED 2026-08-25] 27 of 120 section_types have an advisory winner whose function differs from the section_type (27 of 117 when filed the day before — the set grows). They partition by what a broken pin would produce: 15 would hit a real but different row (loud refusal, naming a contract the writer was never shown — the wrong-cause retry damage of bugs_open/345 and 337) and 12 would find nothing (silent parallel duplicate, because the field-contract guard at :451 is vacuous when isRegeneration is false).

SEVERITY, STATED HONESTLY. This is latent. [MEASURED 2026-08-25] agent_error_log carries ZERO component_validation_rejected rows attributable to this class: the removes/renames curve runs 10 (08-15), 9 (08-17), 74 (08-18), 4 (08-19), then zero on 08-20 and 08-21, and exactly one on 08-22 where function == section_type so no divergence was possible. This lane initially believed eight cancelled needs_new_component items were this bug's damage and REFUTED that itself: the row that made them look like a divergence was created 2026-08-21 18:19Z, four days AFTER the 08-17 refusals, and the advisory's fallback resolver shipped 08-22 — those eight are bugs_open/337's blind-writer casualties, since fixed. That correction is logged in WRONG_CALLS.md and in the lane NOTES. Pin obedience is 11 of 11 observed, which with n=11 and zero failures puts the 95% upper bound on the disobedience rate near 24% — it establishes nothing, and one purpose of this change is to replace that unmeasurable with a durable count.

CLC-006's STATED REASON FOR NEVER BUILDING THIS IS RESPECTED, NOT OVERRIDDEN. It reads 'multiple components per section_type can be legitimate'. This change alters WHICH row a regeneration lands on, never HOW MANY rows a section_type may have. Nothing is refused, renamed or reconciled.

CONSUMERS, ENUMERATED RATHER THAN ASSERTED (2026-07-29 ruling 3). [MEASURED 2026-08-25] against agent_definitions: exactly one live agent uses either action — component-creator, two steps (load_existing_component, store_generated_component). No other active, non-snapshot definition references them. The three lanes whose code sits nearest were told directly and replied: 345 (no file overlap; its repeat detector compares the refusal message byte-for-byte, so this change deliberately does not alter that text), 378 (no overlap; migration 610 will DROP content_components.usage_count and this change does not touch the birth INSERT's column list or reintroduce that column), 283 (the per-instance conversions write by direct id-keyed UPDATE at fix_component_template_action.go:1178,1374 and never call store_generated_component — one grep hit across four files and it is a comment).

NO ORDERING CONSTRAINT IS CLAIMED, because none exists (2026-07-29 ruling 2). The optional key is inert against the old binary, whose spec does not declare it; the new binary without the wire simply runs un-pinned. Either order is safe and this is stated rather than pretended.

plan.summary: Carry the advisory's RESOLVED ROW ID through the workflow and make the store's write target that id, with bugs_open/311's diversion decision re-applied at write time on top of it. Offer and enforcement become one computation's result rather than two resolvers joined by a prompt sentence. The LLM keeps authority over the function name it writes into its template; it loses authority over which row is overwritten. Ships behind an optional config key whose absence is byte-identical to today (RFC_022 / the 2026-08-02 opt-in ruling), and the residual — every future divergence, every vanished pin, every un-pinned parallel birth — becomes three durable finding codes instead of an inference.

edits.rationale: The bugs_open/311 diversion decision must be enterable with an ALREADY-RESOLVED row, or a pinned identity cannot compose with it and the fix would silently re-open 311 (one site's build overwriting another site's component). Splitting rather than duplicating is the point: decideStorageIdentity holds lines 80-150 VERBATIM — unknown-requester legacy regen, the census fail-open, the scoped mint, the double-collision refusal — so the pinned path and the legacy path cannot drift, which is the same one-computation argument 016b §9/092 was approved on. lookupComponentByID additionally scans `function`, because the pin's divergence check needs the ADVISED name, not the possibly scope-minted final one. resolveStorageIdentity itself becomes lookup + decide and is behaviour-identical.

Emit the pin, and cure the primary path's blind spot. The primary section_type query gains id::text, and the row it finds is routed through resolveStorageIdentityByID with the requester read from the same two collected_data paths the store reads. That fixes a defect this file's own header already describes but only cures on the FALLBACK path: on a divert-to-create there is no contract and advising one manufactures a source-vocabulary refusal, and on a divert-to-existing-scoped-row the real contract is the SCOPED row's schema. Every return path gains component_id — INCLUDING the no-schema-fields branch at :195-199, which today keeps an identity and loses its pin because the prompt gates the pin on field_names. The two fail-opens stay independent and the action still never errors: any resolver problem degrades to today's un-pinned advice, blind rather than blocking, with the store-time guard still the backstop. The header's 'stays primary so nothing that works today changes' sentence is superseded and must say so rather than be quietly deleted.

The store honours the pin. 'advised_identity' joins the Optional spec (5 -> 6 against N=10, so no accumulated-surface review is owed under WFA-013). When the pin carries a component_id the identity resolves BY ID; otherwise today's call runs verbatim, which is what makes absence the safe default. A vanished pin logs COMPONENT_ADVISED_ROW_VANISHED and falls back rather than failing, because the advisory is advisory and a deleted row must not break a build. A divergence between the emitted function and the ADVISED function logs COMPONENT_FUNCTION_PIN_DIVERGENCE — harmless now that the pin decides the row, which is exactly why it is worth recording: it converts pin obedience from a sample of 11 into a standing count. On the creation path, un-pinned and not diverted, one COUNT(*) census over active non-forked section-level rows sharing the section_type records COMPONENT_PARALLEL_SECTION_BIRTH — deliberately a DIFFERENT query from the one that resolved the identity, because bugs_open/324 shipped 32 dangling rows by letting a completeness check re-grep the resolver's own patterns. Nothing downstream of functionName = ident.FunctionName changes: separateInlineJS, the field-contract guard, the UPDATE and the INSERT are untouched. The birth INSERT's column list is NOT touched and usage_count is NOT reintroduced — bugs_open/378's pending migration 610 depends on that. The 'removes/renames' refusal TEXT is unchanged, because bugs_open/345's repeat detector compares it byte-for-byte.

This file already drives StoreGeneratedComponentAction end to end under sqlmock with the mutation-proof idiom stated in its own header, and it is the ONLY file driving the store's create path end to end (grepped 2026-08-25), so the new census query ripples nowhere else. Each test names the mutation that must turn it red, because a mock's own bookkeeping cannot assert a negative. The 311-composition test is the important one: a pinned row WITH a foreign dependent must still divert, and the mutation that proves it is setting IsRegeneration=true on the pinned path without calling decideStorageIdentity — which makes the incumbent UPDATE hit an expectation that does not exist. That is a real negative proven by mutation rather than by counting mock calls.

TestLoadExistingComponent_SectionTypeHitDoesNotConsultTheResolver (:85) pins the DEFECT — it asserts that a primary hit does not consult the identity resolver, which is precisely the behaviour being corrected. It is REWRITTEN with a header saying why, not deleted: a peer lane holding that test as evidence must find the correction rather than an absence, and a silently removed test is indistinguishable from one that was never there. The no-schema-fields test closes the branch where an identity resolves and its pin is lost.

edits.rationale: Two halves of one arming, snapshot-first and each anchored on a verbatim line with a DO/RAISE guard that aborts on zero or more than one occurrence — a verify block of bare SELECTs cannot stop a COMMIT, because ON_ERROR_STOP ignores a non-empty result set. (a) adds "advised_identity?": "existing_component" to the store_component step config. The ? OPTIONAL-EXPLICIT marker is a SUFFIX (MarkedConfigKey, datahelpers/action_inputs.go:631-635) and is deliberate: a bare dotless wire is resolvable by the whole-tree search, and a field that decides WHICH ROW IS OVERWRITTEN must resolve from its declared path or not at all. (b) re-gates the two pin sentences out of {{if .existing_component.field_names}} into their own {{if .existing_component.function}} block, so an identity that resolved with an empty schema still pins. No ordering constraint is claimed because none exists: the key is inert against a binary whose spec does not declare it, and the new binary without the wire runs un-pinned.

Declared in the SAME commit as the code that writes them, because findingcodes_scan_test.go discovers codes written by the actions package and the daily finding-code-registry-check CronJob goes red within a day of first fire. [MEASURED 2026-08-25] the unruled bucket is at its cap, exactly 25 of 25, so parking is not available and these ship with a real disposition: instrumented, owning doc bugs_open/388, review_by 2026-09-25. The wire ack is grouped here because it is the same governance concern in the same directory: one row whose downstream statement records what was actually read — an absent advised_identity means GetRaw returns nil and the legacy branch runs verbatim, which is a safe no-op rather than an empty string something will persist.

### CLC-0NN — Advised storage identity pin: the birth gate's contract row carried BY ID from advisory to store
- **relations:** CLC-006 (this is its unbuilt store-side half; its 'advisory-only and unbuilt' line is superseded); CLC-004 (the prompt function pin, now re-gated so it survives an empty schema); CLC-020 (resolveStorageIdentity — the diversion decision this re-uses verbatim rather than reimplementing); RFC_034 §1 (the id-not-function precedent)

grounded_in: CODE, load-side resolver: load_existing_component_action.go:170-179 — `SELECT function, input_schema FROM content_components WHERE section_type = $1 AND forked_from IS NULL AND is_active = true AND component_level = 'section' ORDER BY <ComponentUsageSitesSQL> DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1`.

CODE, store-side derivation: store_generated_component_action.go:798-806 — `if fn, ok := data["function"].(string); ok && fn != "" { functionName = fn } else { functionName = sectionType }`, then `functionName = datahelpers.NormaliseToKebab(functionName)`. The LLM's emitted value is PRIMARY; the section_type derivation is the fallback. This refutes the bug file's [INFERRED] claim, which the file itself marked.

CODE, why a name cannot be an identity: component_storage_identity.go:167-176 — `WHERE function = $1 AND forked_from IS NULL ORDER BY is_active DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1`. No component_level filter, no is_active filter (the latter removed 2026-05-06, documented in the function's own comment).

LIVE MEASUREMENT 2026-08-25: over 330 non-forked content_components rows, 25 function values carry more than one row. site-footer and site-header carry FIVE each and span component_level section AND site; head spans head and section; header-docs spans header and section; tool-agent-complexity-estimator spans section and tool. The store's LIMIT 1 over `is_active DESC, updated_at DESC` therefore picks among several rows by recency, and that choice can change with no code change.

LIVE MEASUREMENT 2026-08-25: 27 of 120 section_types have an advisory winner whose function differs from the section_type (27 of 117 on 2026-08-24 — the set grew by 3 in one day). Partitioned by consequence: 15 would resolve a real but DIFFERENT row (loud refusal against a contract the writer was never shown), 12 would resolve NOTHING (silent parallel duplicate, since the field-contract guard is vacuous when isRegeneration is false).

LIVE MEASUREMENT 2026-08-25, llm_call_log: 672 component-creator/generate_template calls all-history; 11 ever rendered the function pin; 11 of 11 obeyed it; 0 disobeyed. Since the pin shipped 2026-08-22, 37 calls of which 7 carried the regeneration block. With n=11 and zero failures the 95% upper bound on the disobedience rate is roughly 24% — this sample cannot distinguish 'always obeyed' from 'obeyed four times in five', which is why the fix replaces it with a durable count rather than resting on it.

LIVE MEASUREMENT 2026-08-25: the historical fingerprint. Two section_types carry a duplicate pair born from the `generated` route — tool-archetype-taster-quiz (archetype-taster-quiz 2026-04-13, then tool-archetype-taster-quiz 2026-05-06) and tool-gripper-payload-calculator (gripper-payload-calculator 2026-05-01, then tool-gripper-payload-calculator 2026-05-06). Both second rows carry function == section_type, the signature of the section_type fallback derivation. created_from is what separates this from noise: the hero pool has 7 rows and looks worse, but all 7 are `manual` and are deliberate vocabulary.

NEGATIVE MEASUREMENT 2026-08-25, stated because it bounds the severity claim: agent_error_log carries ZERO component_validation_rejected rows attributable to this class. removes/renames runs 10 (08-15), 9 (08-17), 74 (08-18), 4 (08-19), zero on 08-20 and 08-21, one on 08-22 — and that one is loans-application-tracker, where function == section_type, so no divergence was possible. This bug is LATENT. An earlier reading of this lane's that eight cancelled needs_new_component items were its damage was REFUTED BY THIS LANE on the dates: the row that made them look like a divergence was created 2026-08-21 18:19Z, four days after the 08-17 refusals, and the advisory's fallback shipped 08-22. Those eight are bugs_open/337's blind-writer casualties. Logged in WRONG_CALLS.md.

PRIOR ART, and it is the strongest single ground: docs026_concept_register/register/component-lifecycle.md, CLC-006 'F4 — regen-vs-create keyed on the LLM-chosen function (silent fork)', status partial — 'a store-side advisory (warn when function misses but an active same-section_type row exists) is deliberately advisory-only and unbuilt, since multiple components per section_type can be legitimate', verify-later: 'duplicate non-forked function rows in content_components; whether any store-side advisory exists'. Both now answered; both answers are the bad one. That last clause is also a live CONSTRAINT this plan honours: it changes which row is overwritten, never how many rows a section_type may have.

PRECEDENT for the id-not-function rule: architecture_review/RFC_034 §1, recorded there as a measured correction — 'Convert by content_components.id, never by function; a function-keyed conversion would also silently skip 9 forked rows.' The 283 lane confirmed 2026-08-25 that its conversions write by direct id-keyed UPDATE (fix_component_template_action.go:1178,1374) and never call store_generated_component.

PRECEDENT for the shape: bugs_open/337's fix (e1951c24b) made the advisory call the guard's OWN loader and formatter so offer and enforcement are one computation, which is bugs_open/282's remedy and the shape 016b §9/092 already shipped and had approved. This plan applies the same argument to the identity, which 337 left keyed on a name.

CONSUMERS ENUMERATED 2026-08-25 against agent_definitions (active, non-snapshot, not deleted): exactly one agent uses either action — component-creator, steps load_existing_component and store_generated_component. The four adjacent lanes were told directly rather than merely measured (2026-07-29 ruling 3); 345, 378 and 283 replied with measured no-conflicts, quoted in the lane NOTES.

CONSTRAINT from bugs_open/378, verified 2026-08-25: migration 610_content_components_drop_dead_usage_count_HOLD.sql is committed and deliberately unapplied. Naming a column in an INSERT is enough to break every component creation once it is dropped, so this plan does not touch the birth INSERT's column list and does not reintroduce usage_count.
CONSTRAINT from bugs_open/345, verified 2026-08-25: its repeat detector compares the refusal message BYTE-FOR-BYTE, so this plan deliberately leaves the 'removes/renames' refusal text unchanged.

GOVERNANCE MEASUREMENT 2026-08-25: finding_code_registry.json's unruled bucket is at its cap, exactly 25 of 25, so the three new codes cannot be parked and ship at disposition `instrumented`. Optional-key budget for store_generated_component moves 5 -> 6 against N=10, so no accumulated-surface review is owed under WFA-013.

MARKER GRAMMAR, read from the parser rather than from the convention's name: MarkedConfigKey at datahelpers/action_inputs.go:631-635 is `strings.HasSuffix(key, "?")`. The live config surface agrees — related_pages?, component_id?, page_type?, replace_existing?. An earlier draft of this plan wrote the marker as a PREFIX; that would have matched nothing and left the pin silently absent on every run, a failure indistinguishable from the fix working, since an absent pin is a legal state that falls back to today's behaviour.
plan.risks:
1. THE ADVISORY GOES QUIETER ON FOREIGN-DEPENDED PRIMARY ROWS, and that is a real behaviour change, not just a cure. Fixing the primary path's blind spot means a divert-to-create now advises NOTHING where today it advises the incumbent's fields. That matches what the store will actually do — advising a contract the store is about to divert away from is how an advisory manufactures a refusal — but it does reduce how often the writer is told anything. MEASUREMENT THAT SETTLES IT: the share of generate_template calls rendering the regeneration block, baseline 7 of 37 since 2026-08-22, read against the scoped-twin birth rate, which must NOT rise because store-side diversion decisions are unchanged.

2. THE ADVISE-TO-STORE RACE IS NEW SURFACE. A pinned row can be deleted, forked or deactivated between advice and store. The fallback handles it, but silently would be wrong, so COMPONENT_ADVISED_ROW_VANISHED counts it. MEASUREMENT: expected count is approximately zero; a sustained non-zero rate means the pin should carry a schema snapshot as well as an id, and that would be a follow-up round rather than a patch.

3. THE PIN COULD BE BYPASSED BY THE INPUT RESOLVER'S WHOLE-TREE SEARCH, which is exactly the class action_inputs.go records. Closed by the ? OPTIONAL-EXPLICIT suffix, which resolves the declared path or leaves the field absent. MEASUREMENT: zero bypass rows for this field, and `config-key-audit --optional-explicit-wires` exiting 0 with the ack present.

4. THE GO HALF IS INERT UNTIL THE CHASSIS ROLLS WHILE MIGRATION 611 IS LIVE IMMEDIATELY. Safe in both orders and this is argued rather than assumed: the optional key is inert against a binary whose spec does not declare it, and the new binary without the wire runs un-pinned. VERIFY post-roll at the build-provenance line with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`, PER SERVICE — a release can straddle several sessions' commits.

5. A CHANGE OF WHICH ROW A REGENERATION LANDS ON MOVES ELEMENT-ID TOKENS. The 283 lane measured this for us on 2026-08-25 and it is a stated negative rather than a hope: InstanceToken derives from `function`, so a regeneration landing on a differently-named row changes that component's element ids at the next rerender and page_components.rendered_html_digest takes a new value. All six digest writers compute the digest in the same statement as the bytes, and all readers (page_component_divergence.go:68, site_component_divergence.go:70/120, livespec.go:203/215) compare stored digest to STORED bytes, never against a fresh render. So nothing breaks.

6. THE FIRST LIVE EXERCISE MUST HAVE DEMAND. After the roll and 611, regenerate ONE component whose section_type is among the 27 and confirm the UPDATE landed on the advised id, that no new row was born, and that the divergence finding recorded the writer's counterfactual choice. A post-fix zero with no demand measures nothing — that is this estate's most frequently repeated instrumentation error and this lane has already logged one dating failure today.

7. THE DETECTION MUST NOT ANSWER ITSELF. bugs_open/324 shipped 32 dangling rows because its completeness check re-grepped the renamer's own patterns. COMPONENT_PARALLEL_SECTION_BIRTH is therefore a census over section_type — deliberately a different query from the by-id lookup that resolved the identity. If a reviewer can show it collapses to the same question, that is a real objection and the code should change, not the wording.
